# Recursively Realized Distinguishability

**R2D** is a framework for understanding physical and biological systems from a primitive architecture of recursive counting.

This website is the living home of the R2D project.

## The Project

R2D begins with a simple premise:

> Counting requires distinguishability.

From this starting point, the framework develops a recursive architecture connecting multiplicity, constraint, recurrence, and scale.

## R2D Canon

The formal R2D canon, addenda, applications, and supporting essays will be collected here.
